SETTINGS_VAULT.Menu.name: Settings Vault
SETTINGS_VAULT.Menu.label: Open the vault

SETTINGS_VAULT.Keybinding.open.name: Open Settings Vault

SETTINGS_VAULT.App.title: Settings Vault
SETTINGS_VAULT.App.empty: No package in this world has registered a setting.
SETTINGS_VAULT.App.label: Label
SETTINGS_VAULT.App.includeSecrets: Include values that look like credentials
SETTINGS_VAULT.App.includeSecretsHint: {count} setting(s) have a key naming a token, password or licence. They stay out of the file unless you tick this. Read a profile before you share it.
SETTINGS_VAULT.App.importHint: World settings apply to everyone. Client settings land on this device. User settings land on you, because Foundry writes them against the logged-in user and offers no way to write another user's.
SETTINGS_VAULT.Confirm.title: Apply this profile?
SETTINGS_VAULT.Confirm.body: This writes {count} value(s) over what the world holds now. Export first if you want a way back.
SETTINGS_VAULT.Report.title: Last import
SETTINGS_VAULT.Notify.unreadable: That file is not valid JSON.
SETTINGS_VAULT.Notify.wrongFormat: That file is not a Settings Vault profile.

SETTINGS_VAULT.UpdatesMenu.label: Check for updates
SETTINGS_VAULT.UpdatesMenu.hint: See which installed modules have a newer release, and what changed.
SETTINGS_VAULT.Keybinding.updates.name: Open Module Updates
SETTINGS_VAULT.Keybinding.updates.hint: Opens the updates window. No key is bound by default.
SETTINGS_VAULT.Updates.title: Module Updates
SETTINGS_VAULT.Updates.never: Not checked in this world yet.
SETTINGS_VAULT.Updates.empty: No other module is installed in this world.
SETTINGS_VAULT.Updates.budget: {count} module(s) were left out of this check. GitHub allows a limited number of requests an hour. Press check again later.
SETTINGS_VAULT.Updates.howItWorks: Releases are read from GitHub, once a day at most, and only when you ask. A module hosted elsewhere cannot be checked from inside a world. Nothing here installs anything: use Foundry's own module installer.
